column1: # zvariant 5.12.0's encoding of every value shape the AT-SPI publisher sends or
# (a11y ruling, decision 5), so aterm-dbus is held to zvariant with no zbus or
# The oracle: tests/recorder, a crate outside the workspace on the workspace
# 1.0.228, winnow 1.0.3), built with targo --unverified on macOS arm64. Each
# value, written in zvariant's own types (tuples for structs, BTreeMap for
# dicts so the entry order is fixed, Vec for arrays, Value for variants).
# tests/zvariant_values.rs builds the same value by name.
# offset: the message offset the value starts at (zvariant's `position`), so
# padding before an aligned value is part of the recorded bytes.
